SELECT t.id, t.account_sets_id AS accountSetsId, t.tax_type AS taxType, t.check_date AS checkDate, a.credit_code AS creditCode, a.province AS province, a.vat_type AS vatType, a.company_name AS companyName, COALESCE(t2.sort, 999999) AS sort FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_tax t INNER JOIN ( SELECT t2.tax_type, t2.account_sets_id, MAX(t2.id) AS max_id FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_tax t2 WHERE t2.check_date = "2025-12-01" GROUP BY t2.tax_type, t2.account_sets_id ) max_ids ON t.tax_type = max_ids.tax_type AND t.account_sets_id = max_ids.account_sets_id AND t.id = max_ids.max_id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets a ON t.account_sets_id = a.id left join fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas on ffuas.account_sets_id = a.id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_tax_table_sort t2 ON t.tax_type = t2.tax_type WHERE t.check_date = "2025-12-01" AND t.state = 0
and a.province in ( "shaanxi","qingdao","liaoning","jilin","jiangxi") and ffuas.user_id in( '781841492427305006','721059376894490497','794487206395019484','801504833780875670') ORDER BY a.province ASC, t.account_sets_id ASC, COALESCE(t2.sort, 999999) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.account_sets_id AS accountSetsId, t.check_date AS checkDate, a.credit_code AS creditCode, a.province AS province, a.company_name AS companyName FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_payment t INNER JOIN ( SELECT t2.account_sets_id, MAX(t2.id) AS max_id FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_payment t2 LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets a2 ON t2.account_sets_id = a2.id WHERE t2.check_date = :checkDate #[AND a2.province = :province] GROUP BY t2.account_sets_id ) max_ids ON t.account_sets_id = max_ids.account_sets_id AND t.id = max_ids.max_id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets a ON t.account_sets_id = a.id WHERE a.id = '777101825773148051' and t.check_date = :checkDate AND t.state = 0 #[AND a.province = :province] ORDER BY a.province ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ffas.id AS accountSetsId, ffas.province AS province, ffas.company_name AS companyName, -- 只有当取票结果为 1（成功）时，进销项汇总才有效，否则置为空 CASE WHEN taskInvoice.result = 1 THEN COALESCE(xiaoxiang.xiaoxiangsum, 0) ELSE NULL END AS outputTaxSum, CASE WHEN taskInvoice.result = 1 THEN COALESCE(jinxiang.jinxiangsum, 0) ELSE NULL END AS inputTaxSum, CASE WHEN taskInvoice.result = 1 THEN COALESCE(xiaoxiang.xiaoxiangsum, 0) - COALESCE(jinxiang.jinxiangsum, 0) ELSE NULL END AS taxDiff, -- 是否需要找进项：仅在取票成功时根据差额判断 CASE WHEN taskInvoice.result = 1 AND COALESCE(xiaoxiang.xiaoxiangsum, 0) > COALESCE(jinxiang.jinxiangsum, 0) THEN '需要找进项' WHEN taskInvoice.result = 1 THEN '不需要' ELSE NULL END AS needInputFlag, taskInvoice.result AS ticketResult, taskInvoice.failure_reason AS failureReason, taskInvoice.end_time AS updateTime FROM fxy_financial_account_sets ffas LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(ffi.tax_amount) AS xiaoxiangsum, ffi.account_sets_id FROM fxy_financial_invoice ffi WHERE ffi.assignment_date >= :startAssignmentDate AND ffi.assignment_date <= :endAssignmentDate AND ffi.type = 0 GROUP BY ffi.account_sets_id ) xiaoxiang ON xiaoxiang.account_sets_id = ffas.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(ffi.tax_amount) AS jinxiangsum, ffi.account_sets_id FROM fxy_financial_invoice ffi WHERE ffi.assignment_date >= :startAssignmentDate AND ffi.assignment_date <= :endAssignmentDate AND ffi.type = 1 GROUP BY ffi.account_sets_id ) jinxiang ON jinxiang.account_sets_id = ffas.id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas ON ffas.id = ffuas.account_sets_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fftti.account_sets_id AS account_sets_id, fftti.result AS result, fftti.failure_reason AS failure_reason, fftti.end_time AS end_time FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_invoice fftti INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(a.id) AS maxId, a.account_sets_id AS account_sets_id FROM fxy_financial_timed_task_invoice a WHERE a.check_date = :checkDate GROUP BY a.account_sets_id ) maxIdOfInvoice ON fftti.id = maxIdOfInvoice.maxId AND fftti.account_sets_id = maxIdOfInvoice.account_sets_id WHERE fftti.check_date = :checkDate ) taskInvoice ON taskInvoice.account_sets_id = ffas.id WHERE ffas.vat_type = :vatType AND ffas.deactivated IS FALSE AND ffuas.user_id = :userId ORDER BY ffas.province, ffas.company_name

WITH numbered_data AS ( SELECT ffas.id AS accountSetsId, ffas.credit_code AS creditCode, ffas.province AS province, ffas.company_name AS companyName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ffas.province ORDER BY ffas.id ASC) AS rn, COALESCE(fftba.min_first_sort_one, 999999) AS min_first_sort_one FROM fxy_financial_account_sets ffas LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas ON ffas.id = ffuas.account_sets_id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address fftba ON ffas.province = fftba.pin_yin WHERE 1 = 1 AND ffas.vat_type = "SMALL_SCALE" AND ffas.province IN ("anhui", "beijing", "chongqing", "dalian", "fujian", "gansu", "guangdong", "guangxi", "guizhou", "hainan", "hebei", "heilongjiang", "henan", "hubei", "hunan", "jiangsu", "jiangxi") AND ffas.deactivated IS FALSE AND ffuas.user_id IN ( '781841492427305006', '721059376894490497', '794487206395019484', '801504833780875670' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_tax_declare fftd WHERE ffas.id = fftd.account_sets_id ) ) SELECT accountSetsId, creditCode, province, companyName FROM numbered_data ORDER BY min_first_sort_one ASC, province ASC, rn ASC LIMIT 1

UPDATE fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address SET execute_count_one = IF( max_execute_count_one IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(execute_count_one, 0) >= max_execute_count_one, 0, IF(max_execute_count_one IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(execute_count_one, 0) + 1 >= max_execute_count_one, 0, COALESCE(execute_count_one, 0) + 1)), min_first_sort_one = IF( max_execute_count_one IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(execute_count_one, 0) >= max_execute_count_one OR COALESCE(execute_count_one, 0) + 1 >= max_execute_count_one), COALESCE(min_first_sort_one, 0) + 1, min_first_sort_one) WHERE pin_yin = :province

SELECT ffas.company_name, ffas.province, ffas.credit_code FROM fxy_financial_account_sets ffas WHERE 1 = 1 AND ffas.deactivated IS FALSE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_user_account_sets a WHERE a.account_sets_id = ffas.id AND a.user_id IN (:userIds) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_agent_channel_information b WHERE ffas.credit_code = b.credit_code AND b.function_permissions = :functionPermissions AND b.service_staff REGEXP :serviceStaffPattern ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_tax_table c LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_timed_task_tax d ON c.account_sets_id = d.account_sets_id AND c.check_date = d.check_date WHERE c.account_sets_id = ffas.id AND c.check_date = :checkDate ) ORDER BY ffas.province ASC LIMIT 1
